ns2:section.sectionText: Global Studies: Diversity and Integration in Singapore. This course focuses on multilingualism and multiculturalism as consequences of global migration and how one city-state responds to the challenges and opportunities that multiculturalism brings. More information at: http://www.las.uiuc.edu/coursesabroad/winter.html The course starts during the 2nd 8 weeks term and is completed in Singapore 12/26-1/13. First year Discovery Program course. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
